the volume of the fluid displaced

Within the elastic limit, extension is directly proportional to the applied force

Extension is proportional to the length of the wire

questions.question: Charles' law states that at constant pressure, the volume of a fixed mass of gas is

directly proportional to its absolute temperature

questions.question: Heat is transferred through liquids and gases mainly by

is a poor conductor of heat

from a denser to a less dense medium below the critical angle

increase the current in the circuit

rate of change of magnetic flux linkage

questions.question: Accounting may best be described as the process of

identifying, recording, classifying and reporting financial information

questions.question: The principle of double entry means that every transaction
options: is recorded twice in the same account
must be approved by two persons
is recorded only in the cash book
affects two accounts, one debited and the other credited

questions.question: A book in which transactions are recorded for the first time is called a
questions.explanation: Journals and day books are books of original or prime entry.

questions.question: Credit purchases of goods are recorded in the

options: both a book of original entry and a ledger
a book of original entry only

questions.question: A two-column cash book is used to record

questions.question: Discount allowed is treated in the final accounts as

questions.question: The petty cash book is normally operated on the

questions.question: A debit entry in an account records
questions.explanation: Debit increases assets and expenses; credit increases liabilities, capital and income.

questions.question: A credit entry in an account records
options: an increase in a liability or capital
questions.explanation: Liabilities, capital and revenue all increase on the credit side.

questions.question: The trial balance is prepared mainly to
options: determine the profit for the period
show the financial position of the business
check the arithmetical accuracy of the ledger

questions.question: Which of the following errors will NOT affect the agreement of the trial balance?

Entering different amounts on each side
Error of complete omission of a transaction

record temporarily the difference in the trial balance

questions.question: The purchase of a delivery van for use in the business is

questions.question: Gross profit is calculated as

income and expenditure for a period

questions.question: Fixed assets are assets

acquired for long-term use in the business

questions.question: Working capital is calculated as

loss made on the sale of goods
cash set aside to replace an asset

charged to the profit and loss account

questions.question: In the balance sheet, the provision for doubtful debts is

questions.question: Rent paid in advance at the end of the accounting year is treated as

questions.question: Wages owing to employees at the end of the accounting year are treated as

questions.question: A bank reconciliation statement is prepared to reconcile the

the cash movements of the firm

questions.question: Choose the option opposite in meaning to the word in capital letters: Attendance at the lecture is OPTIONAL.
questions.explanation: What is compulsory must be done; what is optional may be chosen.

questions.question: Choose the option opposite in meaning to the word in capital letters: The court ACQUITTED the accused person.
questions.explanation: To convict is to find guilty; to acquit is to declare not guilty.

questions.question: Choose the option opposite in meaning to the word in capital letters: The arrangement is TEMPORARY.
questions.explanation: Temporary means lasting for a limited time; permanent is its opposite.
questions.subject: Use of English

questions.question: Choose the option opposite in meaning to the word in capital letters: She was RELUCTANT to accept the offer.
questions.explanation: Reluctant means unwilling and hesitant.

options: has a private interest to serve
questions.explanation: To have an axe to grind is to have a selfish or hidden motive.

questions.question: After the scandal, the minister was shown the door. This means that he was
questions.explanation: To be shown the door is to be dismissed or sent away.
questions.subject: Use of English

questions.question: Ngozi let the cat out of the bag at the party. This means that she
questions.explanation: To let the cat out of the bag is to disclose something meant to be kept secret.
questions.subject: Use of English

questions.question: The company is on its last legs. This means that the company is
questions.explanation: To be on one's last legs is to be close to failure or exhaustion.
questions.subject: Use of English

questions.question: Their victory in the competition was a flash in the pan. This means that it was
questions.explanation: A flash in the pan is a sudden success that is not repeated.
questions.subject: Use of English

questions.question: The two families have decided to bury the hatchet. This means that they have decided to
questions.explanation: To bury the hatchet is to make peace after a dispute.

questions.question: The new policy is a double-edged sword. This means that the policy
questions.explanation: A double-edged sword cuts both ways, bringing benefit and harm together.

questions.question: Choose the option that best completes the sentence: Neither the principal nor the teachers ___ present at the assembly.
questions.explanation: With 'neither … nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject, 'teachers'.
questions.subject: Use of English

questions.question: Choose the option that best completes the sentence: Each of the boys ___ a copy of the textbook.
questions.explanation: 'Each' is singular, so it takes a singular verb.
questions.subject: Use of English

questions.question: Choose the option that best completes the sentence: He is one of those students who ___ always complaining.
questions.explanation: The relative pronoun 'who' refers to 'those students', which is plural.
questions.subject: Use of English

questions.question: Choose the option that best completes the sentence: Hardly had I arrived ___ the rain started.
questions.explanation: 'Hardly … when' is the fixed pattern; 'no sooner' takes 'than'.
questions.subject: Use of English

questions.question: Choose the option that best completes the sentence: No sooner had he sat down ___ the bell rang.
questions.explanation: 'No sooner' is always followed by 'than'.
questions.subject: Use of English

questions.question: Choose the option that best completes the sentence: She would rather ___ at home than go to the party.
questions.explanation: 'Would rather' is followed by the bare infinitive.
questions.subject: Use of English

questions.question: Choose the option that best completes the sentence: If I ___ you, I would apologise to the teacher.
questions.explanation: The unreal conditional takes the subjunctive 'were'.
questions.subject: Use of English

questions.question: Choose the option that best completes the sentence: The man ___ car was stolen reported the matter to the police.
questions.explanation: 'Whose' shows possession and introduces the relative clause.
questions.subject: Use of English

questions.question: Choose the option that best completes the sentence: He has been living in this town ___ 2010.
questions.explanation: 'Since' is used with a point in time; 'for' is used with a period.
questions.subject: Use of English

questions.question: Choose the option that best completes the sentence: His mother prevented him ___ leaving the house.
questions.explanation: The verb 'prevent' takes 'from' before the gerund.
questions.subject: Use of English

questions.question: Choose the option that best completes the sentence: The clerk was accused ___ stealing the money.
questions.explanation: One is accused of an offence, though charged with it.
questions.subject: Use of English

questions.question: Choose the option that best completes the sentence: We are looking forward to ___ her at the ceremony.
questions.explanation: 'Look forward to' is followed by a gerund.
questions.subject: Use of English

questions.question: Choose the option that best completes the sentence: The teacher made us ___ the poem aloud.
questions.explanation: After 'make' in the active voice, the bare infinitive is used.
questions.subject: Use of English

questions.question: Choose the option that best completes the sentence: Twenty thousand naira ___ a lot of money to a student.
questions.explanation: A sum of money is treated as a single unit, so the verb is singular.
questions.subject: Use of English

questions.question: Choose the option that best completes the sentence: I wish I ___ the answer to that question.
questions.explanation: After 'I wish', the past form expresses a present regret.
questions.subject: Use of English

questions.question: Choose the option that best completes the sentence: Unless you work hard, you ___ fail the examination.
questions.explanation: 'Unless' already carries the negative, so the main clause stays positive.
questions.subject: Use of English

questions.question: Choose the option that best completes the sentence: The furniture ___ been delivered to the hostel.
questions.explanation: 'Furniture' is an uncountable noun and takes a singular verb.
questions.subject: Use of English

questions.question: Choose the correct plural form of the word 'sheep'.
questions.explanation: 'Sheep' has the same form in the singular and the plural.
questions.subject: Use of English

questions.question: Which of the following words has a vowel sound different from the others?
questions.explanation: 'Great' has the /eɪ/ sound, while the others all have /iː/.
questions.subject: Use of English

questions.question: Which of the following words rhymes with 'though'?
questions.explanation: 'Though' and 'dough' both end in the /əʊ/ sound.
questions.subject: Use of English

questions.question: In which of the following words is the letter 'b' silent?
questions.explanation: The 'b' in 'comb' is not pronounced, as in 'tomb' and 'climb'.
questions.subject: Use of English

questions.question: In the word 'development', the main stress falls on the ___ syllable.
questions.explanation: It is pronounced de-VEL-op-ment, with the stress on 'vel'.
